data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'Iakchē' meaning 'goddess' and 'tas' meaning 'new'. This name was borne by a noblewoman in Chaucer's Canterbury Tales. It signifies God's hidden grace and blessings. The name Jacquetta carries the meaning “God's Hidden Grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jacquetta usually hope their child will grow to embody god's hidden grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
